dedupe_keys.name: openstreetmap tagging guidelines for telecommunication infrastructure telecoms wiki

description: This OpenStreetMap wiki page sets out tagging guidelines for documenting telecommunication features in OpenStreetMap, from submarine fibre-optic cables to mobile phone masts, data centres and telephone exchanges. Contents: sections on long-distance networks (submarine cables, cable landing stations, ground cables and markers), data centres (compute centres, internet exchanges, points of presence), local loop networks (telephone exchanges, connection and distribution points, remote terminals, overhead and underground cables, telephone poles, street cabinets, manhole covers and ducts), radio networks (antennas, masts, towers, communications towers) and local projects. Producer: the volunteer OpenStreetMap community. Coverage: worldwide guidance, with region-specific practice under local projects. Access: a public wiki page. Licence and cost: free to read; the wiki text is CC BY-SA 2.0 unless otherwise noted, and the mapped data themselves follow OpenStreetMap's own licence. Caveats: this is a schema of how to map, not a dataset, and completeness of mapped telecom assets varies widely by country and feature type. Simulation uses: it explains how to extract cables, exchanges, cabinets, masts and data centres from OpenStreetMap to build topology and exposure layers for telecom resilience models. Related record: OpenCellID (data-opencellid), a crowdsourced cell tower database that complements OSM radio mast data.
